Graduate programs
The best way to start a glorious career
Graduate programs
The TU/e Graduate School is organized in a number of Graduate Programs: one or more master’s degree programs (with potentially a number of specialized master tracks) in a certain field, and the matching technological designer’s (EngD) or doctorate (PhD) programs.
By choosing degree programs in a single Graduate Program, you ensure your development as a high-level specialist in your field. You will still have a lot of freedom to customize your degree program, but will also benefit from being part of a coherent set of degree programs.
Below you will find an overview of Graduate Programs within the TU/e Graduate School.

Master Applied Physics
Includes 7 specializations, offering focus areas such as Biophysics, Photonics, and Quantum Science & Technology.
